posts.post: I will die on the hill that skinny jeans were never the problem, the styling was. You just need the right silhouette to make them look sharp instead of tragic. Tell me why everyone is so afraid of a tapered leg right now.

There is a massive difference between looking pretty and having actual diva energy. One is about trying to please people, the other is about wearing clothes that demand space. Which one are you dressing for today?
